top root/inv_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== root/cap.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix C
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/cap.sym"
  xfp d2b0a6b4d81521ca

pin P inout 0 -20
pin N inout 0 20

param C 1p

impl spice spice
  format spice "C{name} {P} {N} {C}"

rect -20 -20 20 20
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -20 -35 R0 {cell}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
== root/inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem root/inv.sym"
  xfp a4f20ac7bedac797

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0

param wn 1
param wp 2
param l 0.15

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -40 0 -20 0
  layer 4
line 20 0 40 0
  layer 4

inst dfp34e ./pmos
  at 0 -60 R0
  name MP
  W wp
  L l
inst y287ds ./nmos
  at 0 60 R0
  name MN
  W wn
  L l

wire cgxvbz -20 -60 -20 60
wire cvcx5p -60 0 -20 0
wire f7tqca 20 -30 20 30
wire zq2q34 20 0 60 0

label 1rt9q5 20 60 R0 0
label 6a5y81 20 -60 R0 vdd!
  global true
label damm8g 20 90 R0 0
label f2kfcv 20 -90 R0 vdd!
  global true

port 3cvwgn -60 0 R0 A
port 642gv3 60 0 R0 Y
== root/inv_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  provenance "xschem root/inv_tb.sch"
  xfp aedc3f4821a4d166

inst 2wkyjt ./vsource
  at -200 0 R0
  name VDD
  dc vdd
inst dyf2xa ./cap
  at 100 0 R0
  name CL
  C 10f
inst fftrn1 ./vsource
  at -100 0 R0
  name VIN
  dc vdd/2
inst w1cby4 ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  wn 0.5

wire 6qzme6 100 -20 100 0
wire s8d5ys 40 0 100 0

label 07584q -200 -30 R0 vdd!
  global true
label 2pavhd -200 30 R0 0
label 7ahapm 100 20 R0 0
label 9zhxjh -100 -30 R0 in
label gpy5d8 40 0 R0 out
label q1qfpj -100 30 R0 0
label q8d2d2 -40 0 R0 in

var vdd 1.8

code corner spice
  | .lib models.lib tt
  | .temp 27
code params spice
code tran spice
  | .tran 1p 1n
== root/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix M
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem root/nmos.sym"
  xfp 61d3fe40784dc67a

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 1
param L 0.15
param nf 1
param model nfet
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u' nf={nf} ad='(({W})*0.29)*1p'"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W='({W})*1u' L='({L})*1u'"

rect -20 -20 20 20
  layer 4
  fill false

stext -20 -35 R0 {cell}
  size 0.2
  layer 3
